verdict.rationale: Heap documents an official web JavaScript snippet with a client-side API surface (identify, resetIdentity, addUserProperties, event properties) and says it aims to be easy to install on most platforms and frameworks, which amounts to a first-party web SDK. The pack never names specific language or mobile SDKs, nor does it show versioning or package distribution, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: explicitly named official SDKs per language/platform (mobile, server), SDK reference docs or package distribution, an OpenAPI spec for generated clients, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: To get started with Heap, paste the following code snippet before your website’s closing `</head>` tag.
we try to make Heap as easy to install as possible on most platforms and frameworks.
The addUserProperties API allows you to attach custom properties to your users, whether they are identified or still anonymous.
